title: Cancer Biology
text: Cancer is a group of diseases characterized by the uncontrolled growth and spread of abnormal cells. It arises from mutations in genes that regulate cell division, including tumor suppressor genes like TP53 and BRCA1, and proto-oncogenes that become oncogenes when mutated. The hallmarks of cancer include sustained proliferative signaling, evasion of growth suppressors, resistance to apoptosis, enabling replicative immortality, and the induction of angiogenesis. Metastasis, the spread of cancer cells to distant sites, is the primary cause of cancer mortality. Treatments include surgery, chemotherapy, radiation, targeted therapy, immunotherapy, and combinations thereof.
